ayahs.1: By the winds sent forth in succession—
ayahs.3: by those scattering rainclouds far and wide—
ayahs.4: by those angels separating truth from falsehood,
ayahs.7: what you are promised will surely come to pass.
ayahs.10: the mountains are blown away like dust,
ayahs.11: and the messengers' appointed time to testify arrives—
ayahs.12: for which Day was all this set?
ayahs.13: For the Day of Final Decision.
ayahs.14: And what will make you realize what the Day of Decision is?
ayahs.15: Woe that Day to those who deny!
ayahs.16: Did We not destroy earlier rejecters?
ayahs.17: And We will make later ones follow them.
ayahs.18: This is how We deal with the wicked.
ayahs.19: Woe that Day to those who deny!
ayahs.20: Did We not create you from a humble fluid,
ayahs.21: placing it in a secure womb
ayahs.23: We measured its development—how excellent are We in doing so!
ayahs.24: Woe that Day to those who deny!
ayahs.25: Have We not made the earth a dwelling
ayahs.26: for the living and the dead,
ayahs.27: set upon it firm mountains, and given you fresh water to drink?
ayahs.28: Woe that Day to those who deny!
ayahs.29: They will be told, 'Proceed into the Fire you used to deny!
ayahs.30: Proceed into a shade of smoke rising in three columns,
ayahs.31: giving neither coolness nor shelter from the flames.
ayahs.32: It hurls sparks as large as fortified castles,
ayahs.33: and as dark as blackened camels.'
ayahs.34: Woe that Day to those who deny!
ayahs.35: That Day they will not speak,
ayahs.36: nor will they be allowed to offer excuses.
ayahs.37: Woe that Day to those who deny!
ayahs.38: Allah will say, 'This is the Day of Decision. We have gathered you with earlier rejecters.
ayahs.39: If you have any scheme to save yourselves, use it against Me now.'
ayahs.40: Woe that Day to those who deny!
ayahs.41: Those who lived with taqwa—living with awareness that Allah sees them—will be amid shade and springs,
ayahs.43: They will be told, 'Eat and drink happily for what you used to do.'
ayahs.44: This is how We reward those who do good.
ayahs.45: Woe that Day to those who deny!
ayahs.46: They will be told, 'Eat and enjoy a little—you are truly wicked.'
ayahs.47: Woe that Day to those who deny!
ayahs.48: When they are told, 'Bow down before Allah,' they do not bow.
ayahs.49: Woe that Day to those who deny!
ayahs.50: After this revelation, what message would they believe in?
